sections.heading: Building the cloud infrastructure
sections.body: Cloud development is a service where our cloud technicians and experts develop, design, and engineer the cloud environment itself.

cards.title: SaaS Development
cards.description: Benefit from the dynamic nature of SaaS to access customizable and scalable software solutions that grow with your business demands.

cards.title: PaaS Development
cards.description: PaaS development guarantees maximum mobility in cloud, enabling us to maintain the development environment through continuous integration.

cards.title: IaaS Development
cards.description: With vast experience in deploying private, public, and hybrid cloud infrastructures, we provide pay-as-you-go access to storage, networking, servers, etc.

sections.title: Achieve 5mn+ daily digital journeys with us

cards.title: Ideation
cards.description: Innovating solutions and ideas based on the analysis of your specific software needs.

cards.title: Cloud App Planning
cards.description: Consulting high-level, functional and technical requirements to software.

cards.title: Business case
cards.description: Creating TCO estimates of your cloud application to explore ways it can be optimized.

cards.title: Cloud App Dev Project Planning
cards.description: A product development & management roadmap with a release plan and a prioritized features list.

cards.title: Cloud app Architecture Design
cards.description: Embracing a DevOps culture to enable agility and higher responsiveness to market demands.

cards.title: Cloud App UX/UI Design
cards.description: UX and UI design is done with a view to ensure higher user conversion & retention.

cards.title: Cloud App Dev
cards.description: Designing a CI/CD pipeline for cloud deployment and integrations with other software.

cards.title: Cloud App QA and Testing
cards.description: Conducting tests to examine functionality, integration, regression, performance, usability, compatibility, and security.

cards.title: Cloud App Support and Evolution
cards.description: Experimenting with features to find the best fit (using A/B testing and other fact-based processes).
